title: Positive, negative, or zero
instruction: number = -3. Print whether it's positive, negative, or zero.
test_suite:
import io, sys
import re

def test_prints_negative():
    captured = io.StringIO()
    sys.stdout = captured
    exec(open("exercise.py").read())
    sys.stdout = sys.__stdout__
    output = captured.getvalue()
    assert output.strip() == "negative"
